en: A monochrome postcard view of a landscaped city park with a wide path bordered by trimmed hedges and large trees forming an arch overhead. Three men in early 20th‑century clothing stand on the path. In the distance, above the trees, rise towers and a smokestack of a townscape. Handwritten-style captions at the bottom read the town name and identify the park as the Stadtpark (city park).
